label: ercot71 noncampd availability
definition: ERCOT-71 LEG A (KEEPER, restored registration): measured per-plant availability for the CAMPD-blind ERCOT gas fleet (Kiamichi 55501 switchable / Hidalgo 55545 / Arthur Von Rosenberg 7512 / EG178 56233 — zero TX-CAMPD rows, so the CAMPD outage overlay is structurally blind to them) on the ercot66-storage-rebasis recipe. Identification: 60-Day DAM disclosure per-plant live HSL + EIA-923 zero months (scripts/derive_ercot_noncampd_availability.py; availability events, never a monthly pin — rule 14; backcast-only, G4 mode-aware seam; zero new DOF). Eliminates the ERCOT-70 blind phantom (+1,226 -> +45 MW on the May-2024 shoulders; Hidalgo -> 0 MW matching its real Apr-May outage) and fixes the superseded keeper's failing 2024 gates (C3a -14.2% -> -7.1%, C3b 0.212 -> 0.160; all three years pass C3a/C3b). Re-determined CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS under rubric v2.6 (owner amendments 2026-07-16, this session — a text-only redetermination, not a re-solve): C3c now gates ERCOT on the RT hourly scarcity tail rather than the DA-expressible tail (2023 model 179h vs RT actual 181h = 0.99x PASS; 2024 26h vs 53h = 0.49x, the run's sole ledgered measured-input caveat, inheriting the ercot66-storage-rebasis keeper's open G-22 RTORPA<=$3 scarcity-formation limitation on the missed DA-shoulder days; 2025 19h vs 31h = 0.61x PASS), and C5b/C5c (storage throughput/shape) retired to report-only for every ISO — the former deciding C5c 2024 FAIL (r=0.451) was scored against nine EIA-930 pre-breakout zeros (EIA-930 only breaks ERCO batteries out from mid-Oct-2024) and no longer gates. The 2023 summer over-shoot the phantom masked (Jun +13.6, Sep +17.4; 2023 C3a +4.7%) and the moderate-shoulder under-pricing remain open model items in their own lanes (2023-summer lane 2; ERCOT-72 composition) but do not affect the determination. The mid-curve belt (LEG B) is NOT armed here — probe-adjudicated inert on the phantom-removed base for the shoulders (its C3a gain is a mis-targeted Jan winter over-lift); registered default-off.
market_story: The four CAMPD-blind CC plants ride flat statistical availability in the model while reality had them out or serving SPP: Hidalgo generated 0.0 MWh across Apr-May 2024 (EIA-923, a real two-month outage) yet the model dispatched it 434-499 MW on every ERCOT-70 target window, and Kiamichi's switchable capacity serves SPP in hours the ERCOT COP marks it off. Removing that phantom supply makes the model serve the same moderate-shoulder load with the real, tighter fleet — CT dispatch rises ~+1 GW toward the measured mix and the 2024 price level recovers (C3a -14.2% -> -7.1%) for the measured physical reason, not an offer retune.
